text:
`python3 -m unittest` now passes: all 16 tests, no failures. I didn't modify any tests. The fixes in `catalog/` were:

- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` left the year as a string. It now converts it to an int.
- **`fees.py`:** `late_fee` added the daily fee to the number of days. It now multiplies them.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events because of an off-by-one in the slice. It now returns the last `n`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3, but the comment and the tests say five. It is now 5.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books` was missing the "Emma" book, so I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`.

For Emma, the docstring only gave the title. I picked the author, year and copy count myself. The tests don't check them, so change them if you have real data.
